gloss: to step down onto; to alight

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {降|お}り{立|た}ちませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {降|お}り{立|た}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {降|お}り{立|た}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to step down onto; to alight and stand; to descend upon (a place)
definitions.explanation: Compound verb emphasizing the moment of setting foot somewhere, often used for significant arrivals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{降|お}り{立|た}つ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I stepped off the plane, a warm wind was blowing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地|ち}→地：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降|お}り{立|た}った。
examples.english: I set foot on Japanese soil for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宇宙|うちゅう}{飛行士|ひこうし}→宇宙飛行士：28176_uchuuhikoushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降|お}り{立|た}った⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The moment the astronaut stepped onto the moon was historic.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Formed from ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (to descend) + ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand), so the picture is of coming down and standing on the spot — the arrival, not the journey.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
・[place]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降|お}り{立|た}つ - to set foot at [place]
・[vehicle]⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{降|お}り{立|た}つ - to step down from [vehicle]

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{地|ち}→地：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降|お}り{立|た}つ - to set foot on the ground
・⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降|お}り{立|た}つ - to arrive at an airport
・⟦{異国|いこく}→異国：13721_ikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地|ち}→地：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{降|お}り{立|た}つ - to set foot in a foreign land

USAGE:
Literary and dramatic where ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ is plain. Reserve it for arrivals that matter — a first visit to a country, a landing on the moon, a celebrity emerging at an airport. Getting off a bus at your usual stop is ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧, not {降|お}り{立|た}つ.
